cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 67% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX +0.33% · WTI +2.65% · Brent -2.09% · NatGas +12.16%. 67% of 67 energy names are green — a broad bid. Grid, Storage & Electrification is doing the heavy lifting at +3.93%.

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Oilfield Services lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +3.93%; weakest is Oilfield Services at -1.57%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: VRT is the standout at +16.97%
cards.body: Leaders: VRT +16.97%, EOSE +6.87%, BE +5.12%, PWR +4.85%, ARRY +3.24%. Laggards: ENPH -16.40%, SEDG -8.86%, BKR -5.64%, NOV -4.94%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.

cards.headline: ENPH moving on no clear catalyst
cards.body: ENPH is -16.63% with no fresh headline this cycle — attention without a story. Volume, not news, is doing the work.
